title: Multi-Agent Transactive Memory
abstract: arXiv:2606.19911v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Decentralized deployment of LLM agents with diverse capabilities motivates infrastructure for knowledge sharing across heterogeneous agent populations. Just as search engines index human-generated artifacts for human problem solving, retrieval systems can organize agent-generated artifacts for reuse across agents, extending retrieval-augmented generation from human-authored documents to agent-generated ones. Agent trajectories in particular encode reusable procedural knowledge, yet are typically discarded after a single use or retained only by the producing agent, forcing newly instantiated agents to rediscover existing solutions. We propose Multi-Agent Transactive Memory (MATM), a framework for population-level storage and retrieval of agent trajectories, where producer agents contribute trajectories to a shared repository and consumer agents retrieve them to improve task execution. translated_abstract: 具有多样化能力的LLM智能体的去中心化部署，催生了对跨异构智能体群体知识共享基础设施的需求。正如搜索引擎为人类的问题解决而索引人类生成的产物一样，检索系统可以组织智能体生成的产物以供智能体之间复用，从而将检索增强生成从人类撰写的文档扩展到智能体生成的内容。尤其是智能体的运行轨迹中编码了可复用的程序性知识，但这些轨迹通常在使用一次后就被丢弃，或仅由产生它们的智能体所保留，迫使新实例化的智能体重新探索已有的解决方案。我们提出多智能体交互记忆（MATM），这是一个面向智能体轨迹的群体级存储与检索框架，其中生产者智能体将轨迹贡献到共享存储库中，消费者智能体则检索这些轨迹以改进任务执行。在具有长程、程序性……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出多智能体交互记忆（MATM）框架，通过群体级的共享存储与检索机制，让智能体能够复用彼此的运行轨迹中所蕴含的程序性知识，从而提升任务执行效率。
en_tdlr: Proposes Multi-Agent Transactive Memory (MATM), a framework for population-level storage and retrieval of agent trajectories, enabling agents to reuse procedural knowledge from shared trajectories across heterogeneous agent populations to improve task execution.
